role_checks.operator: Perform only actions commissioned for the operator role on the current asset and operating state. Operator scope may include observation, bounded diagnostic checks, recovery actions, or bounded adjustments; do not exceed the commissioned action envelope.
role_checks.senior-operator: Perform or approve only actions commissioned for the senior-operator role and preserve any justified override or authorization record.
role_checks.millwright: Localize and intervene only within commissioned millwright authority, preserving test conditions and verification requirements.
role_checks.maintenance: Review the bounded procedure, current evidence, intervention history, and commissioned authority before adjustment.
role_checks.technician: Compare controller intent with the verified physical response within commissioned technician authority.
role_checks.qa: Verify the defect against the active sampling plan and commissioned QA authority.
role_checks.engineering: Review the envelope and evidence before changing the model or approved procedure.
role_checks.plant-manager: Assign or authorize the next qualified owner according to commissioned plant policy; do not treat role assignment as diagnosis.
